name: work-receipts
description: Capture credible evidence of work impact and turn it into useful career material.

interface.shortDescription: Save the impact of your work before you forget it.
interface.longDescription: Capture measurable results and overlooked impact such as decisions unblocked, risks prevented, customer learning, mentorship, and operational resilience. Turn confirmed receipts into performance reviews, resume bullets, interview stories, or public-safe LinkedIn drafts.
interface.developerName: Annie Tsai for Moms in Tech
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me capture a work receipt.
